tools.name: datagovmy_parse_gtfs_static
tools.description: Parse GTFS Static data for a specific transport provider. IMPORTANT: For transit queries like "Show me routes from Rapid Penang", use get_transit_routes directly with the provider name. This is a low-level tool - prefer using get_transit_routes or get_transit_stops for most user queries.

params.name: category
params.description: Category for Prasarana data (required only for prasarana provider)

params.name: provider
params.description: Provider name (e.g., "mybas-johor", "ktmb", "prasarana")

params.name: force_refresh
params.description: Force refresh the cache

tools.name: datagovmy_parse_gtfs_realtime
tools.description: Parse GTFS Realtime data for a specific transport provider. IMPORTANT: For transit queries like "Show me bus locations from Rapid Penang", use this tool directly with the provider name. Common names like "rapid penang", "rapid kuantan", or "mybas johor" are automatically mapped to the correct provider-category pairs.

params.name: category
params.description: Category for Prasarana data (required only for prasarana provider)

params.name: provider
params.description: Provider name (e.g., "mybas-johor", "ktmb", "prasarana")

params.name: force_refresh
params.description: Force refresh the cache

tools.name: datagovmy_get_transit_routes
tools.description: Get transit routes from GTFS data. IMPORTANT: For transit route queries like "Show me bus routes for Rapid Penang", use this tool directly with the provider name.

params.name: category
params.description: Category for Prasarana data (required only for prasarana provider)

params.name: provider
params.description: Provider name (e.g., "mybas-johor", "ktmb", "prasarana")

params.name: route_id
params.description: Specific route ID to filter by

tools.name: datagovmy_get_transit_stops
tools.description: Get transit stops from GTFS data. IMPORTANT: For transit stop queries like "Show me bus stops for Rapid Penang", use this tool directly with the provider name. The tool supports common names like "rapid penang", "rapid kuantan", "ktmb", or "mybas johor" which will be automatically mapped to the correct provider and category. No need to use list_transport_agencies first.

params.name: stop_id
params.description: Specific stop ID to retrieve (optional)

params.name: category
params.description: Category for Prasarana data (required only for prasarana provider)

params.name: provider
params.description: Provider name (e.g., "mybas-johor", "ktmb", "prasarana")

params.name: route_id
params.description: Filter stops by route ID (optional)

tools.name: datagovmy_get_transit_arrivals
tools.description: Get real-time transit arrivals at a specific stop. IMPORTANT: Use this tool directly for queries like "When will the next bus arrive at my stop?" or "Show me arrival times for Rapid Penang buses at stop X".

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of arrivals to return (default: 10)

params.name: stop_id
params.description: ID of the stop to get arrivals for

params.name: category
params.description: Category for Prasarana data (required only for prasarana provider)

params.name: provider
params.description: Provider name (e.g., "mybas-johor", "ktmb", "prasarana", or common names like "rapid penang")

params.name: route_id
params.description: Optional: filter arrivals by route

tools.name: datagovmy_search_transit_stops_by_location
tools.description: Search for transit stops near a named location. IMPORTANT: Use this tool for queries like "Show me bus stops near KLCC" or "What buses stop at KL Sentral?" This tool geocodes the location name to coordinates, then finds nearby stops. CRITICAL: For Rapid KL services, ALWAYS use specific terms in the provider parameter like "rapid kl bus", "rapid rail", "mrt feeder", "lrt", "mrt" instead of using "prasarana" with a separate category parameter. DO NOT use provider="prasarana" with category="rapid-r

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of stops to return (default: 5)

params.name: country
params.description: Country code to limit geocoding results (default: "my" for Malaysia)

params.name: category
params.description: Category for Prasarana data (required only for prasarana provider)

params.name: location
params.description: Location name to search for (e.g., "KLCC", "KL Sentral", "Penang Airport")

params.name: provider
params.description: Provider name (e.g., "mybas-johor", "ktmb", "prasarana", or common names like "rapid penang")

params.name: max_distance
params.description: Maximum distance in kilometers (default: 5)

params.name: arrivals_limit
params.description: Maximum number of arrivals to include per stop (default: 3)

params.name: include_arrivals
params.description: Whether to include upcoming arrivals for each stop (default: true)

params.name: category
params.description: Category for Prasarana data (required only for prasarana provider)

params.name: latitude

params.name: provider
params.description: Provider name (e.g., "mybas-johor", "ktmb", "prasarana", or common names like "rapid penang")

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude of the user's location

params.name: max_distance
params.description: Maximum distance in kilometers (default: 5)
